# PSV seat-tightness policy update
Scope: Pressure Safety Valve

For a pressure safety valve with audible tailpipe hissing and hydrocarbon odour
while operating pressure is below set pressure, the observed condition confirms
failure of the required seat-tightness function and an impaired protection
layer, even before a quantified leak rate is available.

Use likelihood 9 and impact 8 when the valve is the only credited
overpressure-protection device for a high-criticality vessel. The likelihood
reflects the observed failed seat-tightness function. The impact reflects the
consequence if the nonredundant overpressure-protection function is lost.

Do not apply this guidance to certification-tag, register or visual-condition
findings without audible, visible or measured passing evidence.
